tool_schemas.name: getConsoleLogs
tool_schemas.description: Lists console telemetry captured for a browser session and returns a paged result set filtered by level, eventType, url, and time window, ordered by sort; use limit and the opaque cursor to fetch the next page. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if sessionId does not match ^bt_sess_[A-Za-z0-9]+$, if since/until are not RFC 3339 date-times or since > until, if limit is outside 1–500, or if cursor/sort/filters are invalid. Raises UNAUTHORIZED if the caller cannot access the session and NOT_FOUND if the sessionId does not exist.

sessionId.description: Browser session id to read logs from.

level.description: Filter console logs by severity level.

eventType.description: Filter console logs by console event type.

url.description: Filter console logs by associated page URL.

since.description: Only return logs with timestamp at or after this time.

until.description: Only return logs with timestamp at or before this time.

limit.description: Maximum number of logs to return.

cursor.description: Opaque pagination cursor for the next page of results.

tool_schemas.name: getConsoleErrors
tool_schemas.description: Lists console error telemetry for a browser session (errors only) and returns a paged result set filtered by eventType, url, and time window, ordered by sort; use limit and cursor for pagination. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR for an invalid sessionId, malformed since/until (or since > until), invalid limit (outside 1–500), or an invalid cursor/sort/filter value. Raises UNAUTHORIZED if the caller cannot access the session and NOT_FOUND if the sessionId does not exist.

sessionId.description: Browser session id to read console error logs from.

eventType.description: Filter console errors by console event type.

url.description: Filter console errors by associated page URL.

since.description: Only return logs with timestamp at or after this time.

until.description: Only return logs with timestamp at or before this time.

limit.description: Maximum number of logs to return.

cursor.description: Opaque pagination cursor for the next page of results.

tool_schemas.name: getNetworkErrors
tool_schemas.description: Lists network error telemetry for a browser session and returns a paged result set filtered by eventType, request url, HTTP status range, and time window, ordered by sort; use limit and cursor for pagination. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if sessionId is invalid, since/until are invalid or since > until, limit is outside 1–500, httpStatusMin/httpStatusMax are outside 0–999 or httpStatusMin > httpStatusMax, or cursor/sort/filters are invalid. Raises UNAUTHORIZED if the caller cannot access the session and NOT_FOUND if the sessionId does not exist.

sessionId.description: Browser session id to read network error logs from.

eventType.description: Filter network logs by network event type.

url.description: Filter network error logs by request URL.

httpStatusMin.description: Only include entries with http_status greater than or equal to this value.

httpStatusMax.description: Only include entries with http_status less than or equal to this value.

since.description: Only return logs with timestamp at or after this time.

until.description: Only return logs with timestamp at or before this time.

limit.description: Maximum number of logs to return.

cursor.description: Opaque pagination cursor for the next page of results.

tool_schemas.name: getNetworkLogs
tool_schemas.description: Lists network telemetry for a browser session and returns a paged result set filtered by level, eventType, url, httpMethod, httpStatus, requestId, and time window, ordered by sort; use limit and cursor for pagination. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if sessionId is invalid, since/until are invalid or since > until, limit is outside 1–500, httpStatus is outside 0–999, or cursor/sort/filters are invalid. Raises UNAUTHORIZED if the caller cannot access the session and NOT_FOUND if the sessionId does not exist.

sessionId.description: Browser session id to read network logs from.

level.description: Filter network logs by severity level.

eventType.description: Filter network logs by network event type.

url.description: Filter network logs by request URL.

httpMethod.description: Filter network logs by HTTP method (e.g., GET, POST).

httpStatus.description: Filter network logs by exact HTTP status code.

requestId.description: Filter network logs by request id.

since.description: Only return logs with timestamp at or after this time.

until.description: Only return logs with timestamp at or before this time.

limit.description: Maximum number of logs to return.

cursor.description: Opaque pagination cursor for the next page of results.

tool_schemas.name: takeScreenshot
tool_schemas.description: Captures a screenshot from the session’s current tab (viewport or fullPage) and returns a screenshot artifact reference; when storageBackend is inline and includeBase64 is true, the response includes inline_base64, otherwise it returns a handle/location for the chosen backend. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if sessionId is invalid, format is not png|jpeg, quality is provided when format is not jpeg or is outside 1–100, includeBase64 is true when storageBackend is not inline, or storageBackend is invalid. Raises UNAUTHORIZED if the caller cannot access the session, NOT_FOUND if the sessionId does not exist, and CONFLICT if the session is not in a state where a current tab can be captured (for example, no active page).

sessionId.description: Browser session id whose current tab should be captured.

fullPage.description: Whether to capture the full scrollable page instead of just the viewport.

format.description: Image format for the screenshot artifact.

quality.description: JPEG quality (only used when format is jpeg).

storageBackend.description: Where to store the resulting screenshot artifact.

includeBase64.description: Whether to include inline_base64 in the returned artifact when storageBackend is inline.

tool_schemas.name: getSelectedElement
tool_schemas.description: Returns the current selected element snapshot for a browser session, optionally including element_snapshot when includeSnapshot is true. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if sessionId is invalid or includeSnapshot is not a boolean. Raises UNAUTHORIZED if the caller cannot access the session, NOT_FOUND if the sessionId does not exist, and CONFLICT if there is no currently selected element available for the session.

sessionId.description: Browser session id to fetch the current selected element snapshot from.

includeSnapshot.description: Whether to include the element_snapshot data in the response.

tool_schemas.implementation:
def getSelectedElement(sessionId, includeSnapshot=None, **_extra):
    import json, os, datetime, re, uuid, time
    _DB = __import__("os").environ.get("MCP_DB_DIR") or ("./environment_mix/0025000" if __import__("os").path.isdir("./environment_mix/0025000") else "/app/database")
    def _load(n):
        try:
            with open(os.path.join(_DB, n), encoding="utf-8") as f: return json.load(f)
        except Exception: return []
    def _save(n, d):
        with open(os.path.join(_DB, n), "w", encoding="utf-8") as f: json.dump(d, f, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2)
    def _err(code, msg, **x): return {"error": {"code": code, "message": msg, **x}}

    t0 = time.time()
    now = datetime.datetime.utcnow().replace(microsecond=0).isoformat() + "Z"

    def _log_call(status, code=None, message=None, meta=None):
        latency_ms = int((time.time() - t0) * 1000)
        entry = {
            "id": "bt_req_" + uuid.uuid4().hex[:24],
            "service": "BrowserTools",
            "tool": "getSelectedElement",
            "timestamp": now,
            "status": status,
            "latency_ms": latency_ms,
            "session_id": sessionId,
            "error_code": code,
            "error_message": message,
            "meta": meta or {}
        }
        reqs = _load("request_logs.json")
        if not isinstance(reqs, list): reqs = []
        reqs.append(entry)
        _save("request_logs.json", reqs)

    if not isinstance(sessionId, str) or not re.match(r"^bt_sess_[A-Za-z0-9]+$", sessionId):
        _log_call("error", "VALIDATION_ERROR", "sessionId is invalid")
        return _err("VALIDATION_ERROR", "sessionId is invalid")
    if includeSnapshot is not None and not isinstance(includeSnapshot, bool):
        _log_call("error", "VALIDATION_ERROR", "includeSnapshot must be a boolean")
        return _err("VALIDATION_ERROR", "includeSnapshot must be a boolean")
    if includeSnapshot is None:
        includeSnapshot = False

    sessions = _load("browser_sessions.json")
    if not isinstance(sessions, list): sessions = []
    sess = next((s for s in sessions if isinstance(s, dict) and s.get("id") == sessionId), None)
    if not sess:
        _log_call("error", "NOT_FOUND", "sessionId not found")
        return _err("NOT_FOUND", "sessionId not found")

    # Ambient auth: if session exists we treat as accessible in this local store.
    # Return latest available selected_element artifact for this session.
    artifacts = _load("page_artifacts.json")
    if not isinstance(artifacts, list): artifacts = []

    candidates = [
        a for a in artifacts
        if isinstance(a, dict)
        and a.get("session_id") == sessionId
        and a.get("artifact_type") == "selected_element"
        and a.get("status") == "available"
    ]

    def _dt_key(a):
        v = a.get("captured_at") or a.get("updated_at") or a.get("created_at") or ""
        return v

    candidates.sort(key=_dt_key, reverse=True)
    if not candidates:
        # Business rule: create failed artifact when no element selected
        art_id = "bt_art_" + uuid.uuid4().hex[:24]
        failed = {
            "id": art_id,
            "session_id": sessionId,
            "artifact_type": "selected_element",
            "status": "failed",
            "page_url": sess.get("current_url"),
            "mime_type": None,
            "byte_size": None,
            "storage_backend": None,
            "storage_key": None,
            "inline_base64": None,
            "element_selector": None,
            "element_snapshot": None,
            "error_message": "No element is currently selected",
            "captured_at": None,
            "created_at": now,
            "updated_at": now
        }
        artifacts.append(failed)
        _save("page_artifacts.json", artifacts)
        _log_call("error", "CONFLICT", "No currently selected element available")
        return _err("CONFLICT", "No currently selected element available")

    art = dict(candidates[0])
    if not includeSnapshot:
        art["element_snapshot"] = None
    _log_call("ok", meta={"artifact_id": art.get("id")})
    return {"artifact": art}

tool_schemas.name: wipeLogs
tool_schemas.description: Deletes in-memory telemetry for a browser session and returns a confirmation of what was wiped; when source is provided it wipes only that log source, otherwise it wipes both console and network logs. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if sessionId is invalid or source is not one of console|network. Raises UNAUTHORIZED if the caller cannot access the session and NOT_FOUND if the sessionId does not exist.

sessionId.description: Browser session id whose in-memory logs should be wiped.

source.description: Optionally restrict wiping to a single log source.

tool_schemas.name: runAccessibilityAudit
tool_schemas.description: Runs a Lighthouse-style accessibility audit against the session’s current page (optionally waiting waitForIdleMs) and returns a persisted audit result tied to that page. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if sessionId is invalid or waitForIdleMs is outside 0–120000. Raises UNAUTHORIZED if the caller cannot access the session, NOT_FOUND if the sessionId does not exist, and CONFLICT if no active page is available to audit.

sessionId.description: Browser session id whose current page should be audited.

waitForIdleMs.description: Optional delay to wait for the page to become idle before running the audit.

tool_schemas.name: runPerformanceAudit
tool_schemas.description: Runs a Lighthouse-style performance audit against the session’s current page and returns a persisted audit result tied to that page. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if sessionId is invalid. Raises UNAUTHORIZED if the caller cannot access the session, NOT_FOUND if the sessionId does not exist, and CONFLICT if no active page is available to audit.

sessionId.description: Browser session id to run the audit for.

tool_schemas.name: runSEOAudit
tool_schemas.description: Runs a Lighthouse-style SEO audit against the session’s current page and returns a persisted audit result tied to that page. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if sessionId is invalid. Raises UNAUTHORIZED if the caller cannot access the session, NOT_FOUND if the sessionId does not exist, and CONFLICT if no active page is available to audit.

sessionId.description: Browser session id to run the audit for.

tool_schemas.name: runNextJSAudit
tool_schemas.description: Runs a Lighthouse-style Next.js audit against the current page for the given browser session and returns the persisted audit result tied to that session/page. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if sessionId is missing or does not match the required bt_sess_… format, NOT_FOUND if the session does not exist or has no active page to audit, and FORBIDDEN/UNAUTHORIZED if you do not have access to the session. Raises CONFLICT if an audit run is already in progress for the session, and QUOTA_EXCEEDED if you have reached your audit execution limits.

sessionId.description: Browser session id to run the audit for.

tool_schemas.name: runDebuggerMode
tool_schemas.description: Enables Debugger Mode for the given browser session and returns the updated session/mode state indicating that debugging is active. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if sessionId is missing or invalid, NOT_FOUND if the session does not exist, and FORBIDDEN/UNAUTHORIZED if you do not have permission to modify the session. Raises CONFLICT if the session is in a state that cannot enter Debugger Mode (for example, closed) or if an incompatible mode is already active.

sessionId.description: Browser session id to enable debugger mode for.

tool_schemas.name: runAuditMode
tool_schemas.description: Enables Audit Mode for the given browser session and returns the updated session/mode state indicating that audit instrumentation is active. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if sessionId is missing or invalid, NOT_FOUND if the session does not exist, and FORBIDDEN/UNAUTHORIZED if you do not have permission to modify the session. Raises CONFLICT if the session cannot transition into Audit Mode (for example, closed) or if an incompatible mode is already active, and QUOTA_EXCEEDED if enabling audit mode would exceed your plan limits.

sessionId.description: Browser session id to enable audit mode for.

tool_schemas.name: runBestPracticesAudit
tool_schemas.description: Runs a Lighthouse-style Best Practices audit against the current page for the given browser session and returns the persisted audit result tied to that session/page. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if sessionId is missing or does not match the required bt_sess_… format, NOT_FOUND if the session does not exist or has no active page to audit, and FORBIDDEN/UNAUTHORIZED if you do not have access to the session. Raises CONFLICT if an audit run is already in progress for the session, and QUOTA_EXCEEDED if you have reached your audit execution limits.

sessionId.description: Browser session id to run the audit for.

tool_schemas.name: getBrowserSession
tool_schemas.description: Fetches a single browser session by id and returns its current status and telemetry buffer counters. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if sessionId does not match ^bt_sess_[A-Za-z0-9]+$. Raises NOT_FOUND if the session does not exist or is not visible to the caller. Raises UNAUTHORIZED if the caller lacks permission to read the session.

tool_schemas.name: listBrowserSessions
tool_schemas.description: Lists browser sessions visible to the caller and returns a paged result set filtered by status and time window, ordered by sort; use limit and the opaque cursor to fetch the next page. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if filters are malformed, if since/until are not RFC 3339 date-times or since > until, if limit is outside 1–500, or if cursor/sort/status is invalid. Raises UNAUTHORIZED if the caller cannot list sessions.

since.description: Only return sessions with started_at at or after this time.

until.description: Only return sessions with started_at at or before this time.

limit.description: Maximum number of sessions to return.

cursor.description: Opaque pagination cursor for the next page of results.

tool_schemas.name: createBrowserSession
tool_schemas.description: Creates a new browser session and returns the created session record. The session starts in status='active' and may be used immediately to ingest and query telemetry. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if provided fields are invalid. Raises UNAUTHORIZED if the caller cannot create sessions.

userAgent.description: User agent string for the session (as reported by the browser).

isMobile.description: Whether the browser is in mobile emulation mode.

logBufferLimitBytes.description: Maximum in-memory log buffer size in bytes for this session; inserts may be rejected or oldest logs evicted when exceeded.

tool_schemas.name: updateBrowserSession
tool_schemas.description: Updates mutable fields on a browser session and can drive lifecycle transitions for status. Returns the updated session. Refuses to modify closed/expired sessions except where explicitly allowed by the status transition rules. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if sessionId is invalid, if status is not a valid transition, or if fields are malformed. Raises NOT_FOUND if the session does not exist. Raises UNAUTHORIZED if the caller cannot update the session.

status.description: Desired session status; only transitions from active -> closed|expired are permitted.

currentUrl.description: Set the current active page URL for the session.

currentTitle.description: Set the current active page title for the session.

lastSeenAt.description: Update the last-seen timestamp for TTL/expiration tracking.

isMobile.description: Whether the browser is in mobile emulation mode.

viewport.description: Update viewport metadata for the session.

tool_schemas.name: createBrowserLogs
tool_schemas.description: Ingests one or more telemetry log entries for a browser session and returns the created log ids (and any eviction count if the buffer limit required eviction). Enforces the session log buffer quota by rejecting inserts or evicting oldest logs before insert to keep newest logs. Refuses to ingest into closed/expired sessions. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if sessionId is invalid, if any log entry is invalid, if limit/quota rules are violated, or if timestamps are malformed. Raises NOT_FOUND if the session does not exist. Raises UNAUTHORIZED if the caller cannot write logs.

sessionId.description: Browser session id to write logs to.

entries.description: Log entries to append in order; each entry is stored as a browser_logs row.

eventType.description: Event type discriminator, e.g. console.message, console.exception, network.request, network.response, network.failure.

url.description: Associated page URL or request URL.

httpMethod.description: HTTP method for network events (e.g. GET, POST).

httpStatus.description: HTTP status code for network response events.

requestId.description: Request identifier to correlate network events.

payload.description: Arbitrary structured payload for the event.

metadata.name: BrowserTools
metadata.description: BrowserTools stores per-browser-session telemetry (console + network logs), lightweight artifacts (screenshots, selected element snapshots), and on-demand Lighthouse-style audit runs (accessibility, performance, SEO, best-practices, Next.js). The main workflows are: ingest logs during a live session
